mapper.sql: select s.check_id, s.check_no, s.check_date, s.shop_dept_id, shop_dept.dept_name as shop_dept_name, s.warehouse_id, warehouse_dept.dept_name as warehouse_name, s.check_scope, s.category_id, s.sample_size, s.blind_check, s.counter_user_id, s.counter_name, s.deadline, s.recount_threshold, coalesce(detail_summary.item_count, 0) as item_count, coalesce(detail_summary.profit_item_count, 0) as profit_item_count, coalesce(detail_summary.loss_item_count, 0) as loss_item_count, coalesce(detail_summary.total_diff_quantity, 0) as total_diff_quantity, s.status, s.approval_instance_id, s.approval_round, s.approval_engine, s.last_approval_event_key, s.row_version, s.submitted_user_id, s.submitted_by, s.submitted_time, s.approved_user_id, s.approved_by, s.approved_time, s.last_reject_reason, s.last_rejected_user_id, s.last_rejected_by, s.last_rejected_time, s.last_invalid_reason, s.last_invalid_detail_snapshot, s.last_invalidated_time, s.restart_reference_snapshot, s.create_by, s.create_time, s.update_by, s.update_time, s.remark from inv_stock_check s left join sys_dept shop_dept on shop_dept.dept_id = s.shop_dept_id left join sys_dept warehouse_dept on warehouse_dept.dept_id = s.warehouse_id left join ( select check_id, count(1) as item_count, sum(case when diff_type = 'profit' then 1 else 0 end) as profit_item_count, sum(case when diff_type = 'loss' then 1 else 0 end) as loss_item_count, sum(coalesce(diff_qty, 0)) as total_diff_quantity from inv_stock_check_detail group by check_id ) detail_summary on detail_summary.check_id = s.check_id
